players.product: trapped-ion quantum computers (Forte, Forte Enterprise) sold as systems and as cloud access, plus quantum networking, sensing and security products

quarterly_data.signal: IonQ 8-K: IonQ raised its full-year 2026 outlook - revenue expected between $450 million and $460 million, including SkyWater Technology's contribution from July 31, 2026 (its acquisition date) through December 31, 2026 and eliminating estimated intercompany revenues under the pre-existing IonQ-SkyWater commercial agreement. CEO Niccolo de Masi: the updated guidance 'highlights both the market traction of our quantum platform and the foundational manufacturing scale provided by SkyWater.'
